raw_text: The Houthi seizure of MV Galaxy Leader in the Red Sea has raised serious concerns among Indian shipping companies operating in the region. The Shipping Corporation of India has issued an advisory to all its vessels transiting the Bab el-Mandeb strait to maintain heightened vigilance. Several Indian-flagged vessels have altered their routes to maintain greater distance from the Yemeni coastline. Industry sources estimate that re-routing through the Cape of Good Hope could add 10-14 days to India-Europe voyages and significantly increase fuel costs.
